Private Pele 1.12.0 flowchart runtime, generated by `npm run vendor:pele`.

Source: https://github.com/obsidianmd/pele, MIT license in LICENSE. Built from the published `pele/core` and `pele/diagrams/flowchart` exports and src/pele/bridge.js with the versions locked in package-lock.json.

Pele's source is unchanged. The bridge calls its existing fourth flowchart-render argument to capture measured geometry and draw a supplied layout. Bundling gives the bridge its own registry so it cannot replace an application's Pele renderer. Updating Pele requires updating the explicit version guard, regenerating, and running the integration and native-parity tests.
